articles.title: A Baboon's Silvery Fur May Explain Its Link to a Moon God
articles.summary: A new study finds hamadryas baboon fur reflects light almost exactly like the moon — a clue to why ancient Egyptians linked the baboon to Thoth, god of the moon.

articles.title: Knee Surgery Rules Sinner Out of the Australian Open
articles.summary: Jannik Sinner has had knee surgery and will miss the 2027 Australian Open, where he won the title in 2024 and 2025.

articles.title: The Mineral Detective Solving Big Problems With Rocks
articles.summary: Mineral scientist Aaron Celestian uses X-rays, lasers and tools he builds himself to solve real problems — including a mineral that cleans toxic lead from water.
